title: feat(scenarios): a card names its origin and a zh+en title; the gallery exports generic starter and delivery cards
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_

Fixes #30932

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景卡新增必填字段 `origin`(generic / customer-derived / held-out),标题改为中英双语 `{ zh, en }`;九张公开卡全部标为 generic 并补上中文标题;画廊导出器只导出 origin 为 generic、tier 为 starter 或 delivery 的卡,index.json 的中英标题都从卡上取。
- 为什么改:画廊是获客主渠道,按 D1 裁决只能展示通用场景;此前卡上没有明确的"通用"标记,导出器一张卡也导不出,index.json 的中文标题一直是 null。
- 风险与回滚:私有包、不发布;私有 overlay 里的卡在补上 origin 和双语标题之前会被拒收,overlay 里标为 generic 的卡会被拒收;反过来,开放库里标为 customer-derived 或 held-out 的卡也会被拒收;私有 overlay 由其维护者迁移到新卡片形态;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/generic.ts`(导出守卫)、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/loader.ts`(双向拒收:overlay 不收 generic,开放库不收 customer-derived/held-out)、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.ts`(origin 与 title 字段)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/export/exporter.test.ts`,预期 36 个用例全部通过,其中 generic starter 导出成功,customer-derived、held-out 和 control 都被拒。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`origin`, a required card field** (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/schema.ts`): `generic | customer-derived | held-out`, a closed set with a located refusal when missing. It is the explicit marker the exporter reads; `provenance` stays prose for people.
- **The loader knows which library it loads, because the caller says so** (`src/loader.ts`). The loader could not tell the overlay from the open library: a card file carries nothing that says where it lives, and the loader reads whatever directory it is handed. So `LoadOptions` gains a required `library: 'open' | 'overlay'`, and the loader refuses a `generic` card loaded as the `overlay`, and a `customer-derived` or `held-out` card loaded as the `open` library (round 2), both at `origin`. Both CLIs (`run-scenarios`, `export-gallery`) answer it with `libraryOf(dir, repo)`: the repository's `docs/qa/scenarios` by real path is `open`, and any other `--cards` directory is `overlay`.
- **`title` becomes `{ zh, en }`**, both required and non-blank, strict (a third language is an unknown key; the retired one-string shape is refused with the new shape named). Every reader picks a language explicitly:
  - the gallery `index.json`: `title.en` and `title.zh` from the card (`manifest.ts` no longer allows `zh: null`);
  - the app README the exporter writes: `title.en` as the heading, `title.zh` under it;
  - `transcript.md`: `title.en` (its body is English);
  - the runner's `CardRun.title` (the run record): carries the `{ zh, en }` object whole, as data; nothing renders it.
  - The prompts, the scorecard and the runner's console output read no title (checked: no reader there).
- **The exporter guard** (`src/export/generic.ts`): `NO_GENERIC_MARKER` is replaced by `GALLERY_GUARD`, which passes a card only when `origin === 'generic'` AND `tier` is `starter` or `delivery` (the tier rule from the epic ruling comment 6687463653 on #30349), and names every rule a card fails. The option is renamed `isGeneric` to `guard`; the CLI still offers no flag to pass another guard.
- **The nine open-library cards**: each gets `"origin": "generic"` and a Chinese title. Every card's `provenance` says it was written from the domain alone or derived mechanically from a golden corpus case; none says it came from a customer, so none is `customer-derived`.
- **Docs**: `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` (the format's reference) gains an Origin section and the title shape, and its stale "the exporter reads no tier" paragraph is replaced; `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`'s loader example passes `library`.

## Tests

- `test/refusals.test.ts`: no origin; an origin outside the set; the old one-string title; no title; no `zh`; no `en`; an empty `en`; a blank `zh`; a third language. A `generic` card loaded as the overlay is refused at `origin` (directory and single file), with `customer-derived` and `held-out` in the overlay as the green controls. Round 2: a `customer-derived` and a `held-out` card loaded as the open library are each refused at `origin`. `libraryOf` answers `open` for the repository's directory, through a non-canonical spelling and through a symlink, and `overlay` elsewhere.
- `test/library.test.ts`: every open card is `generic` and carries a `zh` title with CJK text that is not the English one.
- `test/export/exporter.test.ts`, on the recorded crm run (`RecordingDriver` over a scripted double, no model): with the default guard a generic `starter` and a generic `delivery` card export, and the index carries both titles; `customer-derived` and `held-out` (starter and delivery) and `control` are each refused with an empty index, and each refusal's control leg exports the same run once the guard lets it through. Over the real library the guard passes the six starter cards and refuses the three control cards for their tier. The CLI end to end refuses the crm card for its tier, and a `--cards` directory outside the repository is loaded as the overlay, where the loader refuses the generic card before the export.
- Ablations (each mutation landed and was restored by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, blob equal to HEAD after restore): the loader's overlay rule disabled turns 2 refusal tests red; the open-library rule (round 2) disabled turns its test red (1 failed, 87 passed); the guard's origin rule disabled turns 4 exporter tests red; the guard's tier rule disabled turns 4 exporter tests red.

## Acceptance notes

- **Consequence for the private overlay.** `origin` and the `{ zh, en }` title are required, so every overlay card is refused until it gains both, and an overlay card marked `generic` is refused. The overlay lives outside this repository; nothing here could migrate it.
- **Both directions (round 2, seat ruling Q1 A):** a `customer-derived` or `held-out` card found in the OPEN library is refused too, so a non-generic card cannot sit in the public tree. The overlay owner migrates its cards to the new shape (Q2 A, one line in `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`), and the loader keeps no lenient conversion. `libraryOf` is unchanged (Q3 A).
- `skip-changeset`: `packages/qa/scenarios` is `private: true` and `docs/qa/scenarios` ships in no package, so nothing published moves.
- Out of scope, untouched: the runner's `owner_id` and seed logic, and `personas[].record`.

## Verification

Head: see the report comment on #30932 for the head sha the gates were run on.
